nodes.summary: If `μₙ` satisfies an LDP with rate function `I`, `F` is lower semicontinuous, `U` is open, `x ∈ U` and `I x < ∞`, then for every `ε > 0`, eventually `exp (n (F x - I x - ε)) ≤ ∫_U exp (n F) dμₙ`.
nodes.title: Local lower bound for a restricted exponential integral

nodes.summary: If `μₙ` satisfies an LDP with rate function `I` (not necessarily good), `F` is continuous with `|F| ≤ C`, `K` is closed and `F x - I x ≤ u` on `K`, then for every `t > u`, eventually `∫_K exp (n F) dμₙ ≤ exp (n t)`. The proof is the finite-partition argument applied to the closed sets `K ∩ F⁻¹' [aⱼ, aⱼ₊₁]`.
nodes.title: Upper bound for a restricted exponential integral

nodes.summary: If `μₙ` satisfies an LDP with rate function `I`, `F` is lower semicontinuous and `U` is open, then `sup_{x ∈ U} (F x - I x) ≤ liminf (1/n) log ∫_U exp (n F) dμₙ`.
nodes.title: Varadhan's lower bound on an open set

nodes.summary: If `μₙ` satisfies an LDP with rate function `I` (not necessarily good), `F` is continuous with `|F| ≤ C` and `K` is closed, then `limsup (1/n) log ∫_K exp (n F) dμₙ ≤ sup_{x ∈ K} (F x - I x)`.
nodes.title: Varadhan's upper bound on a closed set

nodes.summary: `exp a * exp b = exp (a + b)` in `ℝ≥0∞`.
nodes.title: Product of exponential masses

nodes.title: Tilted large deviation principle

nodes.summary: `Qₙ(A) = (∫ exp (n F) dμₙ)⁻¹ * ∫_A exp (n F) dμₙ`.
nodes.title: Mass of a measurable set under a tilted measure

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
